old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a person's face, focusing primarily on their mouth and chin area. The individual has a short beard and mustache, and their skin appears slightly shiny, suggesting they might be sweating or have applied some oil. Throughout the sequence, the person is seen with a black object, which resembles a massager or a similar tool, positioned against their cheek. The person's mouth opens and closes, showing deformation, and a small black droplet of liquid emerges near the lips. The background remains out of focus, ensuring that the viewer's attention stays on the facial area and the action being performed. The lighting is consistent, highlighting the texture of the skin and the beard.

caption: The video captures an extreme close-up of a bearded man's lower face in bright side sunlight against a pale paneled wall. A black ribbed suction-cup device on a metal shaft is pressed to his right cheek at frame-left, gripping a patch of skin and holding it drawn inward into a puckered dimple. His eyes stay wide open and the framing remains locked on the mouth and nose throughout. The cup's pull gradually drags the center of his mouth a little toward the device side. The lips reshape continuously, starting pursed together with only a small central gap, then parting wider to reveal the upper teeth and gums. As the excerpt proceeds the opening rounds into a protruded 'O' pout with the lower lip pushed forward. The metal shaft at the left edge shifts slightly in and out, while the face itself holds its position relative to the frame.
